Subject: MAP: Security evidence onramp & SOC 2 intake — next steps

Hi Jordan / Amir —

Thanks again for the demo and the open conversation this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward a November close window: 

What we heard
- MapleBank wants: predictable latency for customer-facing flows, VPC option for production, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement sign-off.
- Primary blocker: security review + evidence ingestion cadence.

Proposed MAP milestone (security onramp) — action items I suggest we own together:
1) Redwood: deliver SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence checklist (attached). Target deliverable: today EOD PT.
2) MapleBank: designate technical evidence owner + procurement contact. Suggested target: 11/06.
3) Evidence delivery cadence: partial drop by 11/20; remaining items by 11/27.
4) Signatures / procurement: DocuSign MSA routing once evidence checkpoint met — target 11/30.

Dependencies / risks
- If audit team needs additional artifacts (HSM configs, network diagrams), we should surface early; Redwood can provide scans and a package but may need SSO/remote access for certain logs.

Attachments I uploaded for your review: Redwood_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.3.pdf, MapleBank_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (draft with owners). Also shared a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cMAP-v02

Next steps
- Jordan: confirm security owner + whether your team prefers the questionnaire in PDF or a spreadsheet version.
- Amir: confirm any procurement deadlines that would move the close date earlier.
- Vanessa (cc): once we have owners, can you draft milestone owners and timelines in the MAP?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated MAP and a short action tracker.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0137
